notes: The Imam Baqir sits inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); his words («قال لما ولد عيسى») are the saying.
«عليهما السلام» and «- رحمه الله -» are blessings and an honorific: left out.
